. do analysis.do 

. * Workbench 1.8.11
. * project: fpc
. * run: subpopulation
. * lineage_hash: aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa
> aaa
. * Coverage
. * model | model.ols | native_with_equivalence_note | Full single-stage linear
> ization design including supplied FPC and domain; coefficient and joint-test 
> df preserve the executed Workbench convention.
. version 18

. set more off

. set type double

. capture program drop wb_repost

. program define wb_repost, eclass
  1.     args beta covariance
  2.     ereturn repost b=`beta' V=`covariance', rename
  3. end

. capture program drop wb_sha

. program define wb_sha
  1.     args filename expected
  2.     tempfile digestfile
  3.     shell shasum -a 256 "`filename'" > "`digestfile'"
  4.     tempname fh
  5.     file open `fh' using "`digestfile'", read text
  6.     file read `fh' line
  7.     file close `fh'
  8.     if substr("`line'",1,64) != "`expected'" {
  9.         display as error "SHA256 mismatch"
 10.         exit 9
 11.     }
 12. end

. 
. wb_sha "data.csv" "f62814e5454107d2eeee19f780af2dfe46677af0b843e6256413377a80
> c43ccd"


. frame create wb_src0

. frame change wb_src0

. import delimited using "data.csv", varnames(1) delimiters(",") encoding("UTF-
> 8") asdouble clear case(preserve)
(13 vars, 90 obs)

. frame copy wb_src0 wb_model_data1

. frame change wb_model_data1

. drop if missing(y) | missing(x1) | missing(x2)
(0 observations deleted)

. assert !missing(population_fpc) & population_fpc >= 0

. quietly summarize population_fpc, meanonly

. scalar wb_fpc_fraction = (r(max)<=1)

. if !wb_fpc_fraction assert population_fpc>1 & population_fpc==floor(populatio
> n_fpc)

. tempvar wb_fpc_order wb_fpc_stratum wb_fpc_psu wb_fpc_tag wb_fpc_n

. generate long `wb_fpc_order' = _n

. egen long `wb_fpc_stratum' = group(stratum)

. egen long `wb_fpc_psu' = group(`wb_fpc_stratum' psu)

. egen byte `wb_fpc_tag' = tag(`wb_fpc_stratum' `wb_fpc_psu')

. bysort `wb_fpc_stratum': egen long `wb_fpc_n' = total(`wb_fpc_tag')

. bysort `wb_fpc_stratum': assert population_fpc==population_fpc[1]

. if !wb_fpc_fraction assert population_fpc>=`wb_fpc_n'

. sort `wb_fpc_order'

. svyset psu [pw=weight], strata(stratum) fpc(population_fpc) singleunit(missin
> g)

Sampling weights: weight
             VCE: linearized
     Single unit: missing
        Strata 1: stratum
 Sampling unit 1: psu
           FPC 1: population_fpc

. tempvar wb_survey_domain

. generate byte `wb_survey_domain' = (!missing(subpop) & (subpop == 1))

. svy , subpop(`wb_survey_domain'): regress y x1 x2
(running regress on estimation sample)

Survey: Linear regression

Number of strata =  6                                 Number of obs   =     90
Number of PSUs   = 18                                 Population size =  1,665
                                                      Subpop. no. obs =     72
                                                      Subpop. size    =  1,332
                                                      Design df       =     12
                                                      F(2, 11)        =  41.42
                                                      Prob > F        = 0.0000
                                                      R-squared       = 0.6497

------------------------------------------------------------------------------
             |             Linearized
           y | Coefficient  std. err.      t    P>|t|     [95% conf. interval]
-------------+----------------------------------------------------------------
          x1 |    1.07992   .1287628     8.39   0.000       .79937     1.36047
          x2 |  -.3310755   .0735102    -4.50   0.001    -.4912405   -.1709105
       _cons |   5.481671   .6001818     9.13   0.000     4.173987    6.789354
------------------------------------------------------------------------------

. assert e(df_r) > 0

. matrix wb_survey_v = e(V)

. mata: assert(!hasmissing(st_matrix("wb_survey_v")))

. estimates store wb_model1

. generate long wb_sample_row = _n

. generate byte wb_sample1 = e(sample)

. scalar wb_number_0 = _b[_cons]

. scalar wb_number_1 = _b[x1]

. scalar wb_number_2 = _b[x2]

. scalar wb_number_3 = _se[_cons]

. scalar wb_number_4 = _se[x1]

. scalar wb_number_5 = _se[x2]

. scalar wb_number_6 = e(N)

. capture confirm scalar e(df_r)

. if _rc exit 9

. scalar wb_number_7 = (_b[_cons]/_se[_cons])

. scalar wb_number_8 = 2*ttail(e(df_r),abs((_b[_cons]/_se[_cons])))

. scalar wb_number_9 = e(df_r)

. capture confirm scalar e(df_r)

. if _rc exit 9

. scalar wb_number_10 = (_b[x1]/_se[x1])

. scalar wb_number_11 = 2*ttail(e(df_r),abs((_b[x1]/_se[x1])))

. scalar wb_number_12 = e(df_r)

. capture confirm scalar e(df_r)

. if _rc exit 9

. scalar wb_number_13 = (_b[x2]/_se[x2])

. scalar wb_number_14 = 2*ttail(e(df_r),abs((_b[x2]/_se[x2])))

. scalar wb_number_15 = e(df_r)

. file open wb_numbers using "numeric_actual.tsv", write text replace
(file numeric_actual.tsv not found)

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_0) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_1) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_2) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_3) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_4) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_5) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_6) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_7) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_8) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_9) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_10) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_11) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_12) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_13) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_14) _n

. file write wb_numbers %21.17g (wb_number_15) _n

. file close wb_numbers

. * Closing self-checks
. assert !missing(wb_number_0) & abs(wb_number_0-(5.481670504452022)) <= 1e-08+
> 0*abs(5.481670504452022)

. assert !missing(wb_number_1) & abs(wb_number_1-(1.079919971389835)) <= 1e-08+
> 0*abs(1.079919971389835)

. assert !missing(wb_number_2) & abs(wb_number_2-(-0.33107553973184334)) <= 1e-
> 08+0*abs(-0.33107553973184334)

. assert !missing(wb_number_3) & abs(wb_number_3-(0.6001818159582222)) <= 1e-06
> +0*abs(0.6001818159582222)

. assert !missing(wb_number_4) & abs(wb_number_4-(0.1287627592658446)) <= 1e-06
> +0*abs(0.1287627592658446)

. assert !missing(wb_number_5) & abs(wb_number_5-(0.07351021561766335)) <= 1e-0
> 6+0*abs(0.07351021561766335)

. assert !missing(wb_number_6) & abs(wb_number_6-(90)) <= 0.0+0.0*abs(90)

. assert !missing(wb_number_7) & abs(wb_number_7-(9.133349859492567)) <= 1e-08+
> 1e-06*abs(9.133349859492567)

> 1e-05*abs(9.450006446809618e-07)

. assert !missing(wb_number_9) & abs(wb_number_9-(12)) <= 0.0+0.0*abs(12)

. assert !missing(wb_number_10) & abs(wb_number_10-(8.386896782479038)) <= 1e-0
> 8+1e-06*abs(8.386896782479038)

. assert !missing(wb_number_11) & abs(wb_number_11-(2.3108744213975312e-06)) <=
>  0+1e-05*abs(2.3108744213975312e-06)

. assert !missing(wb_number_12) & abs(wb_number_12-(12)) <= 0.0+0.0*abs(12)

. assert !missing(wb_number_13) & abs(wb_number_13-(-4.503803137428032)) <= 1e-
> 08+1e-06*abs(-4.503803137428032)

> 0+1e-05*abs(0.0007218579886188758)
